This New Destination Trailer Has a Front Kitchen, an Enormous Living Room, and Sleeping for Eight
23 photos
Photo: Recreation by Design
In an RV industry full of choices, most people choose the best-known brands like Thor Industries and Forest River, and smaller independent manufacturers are easy to overlook. However, sometimes it’s worth looking at the underdogs as well, as they often offer better build quality, more innovative layouts, and superior customer service.
Recreation by Design is one of these smaller companies, and today, I’m going to take a look at their new 2027 Baypoint 435 destination trailer, which is designed for families and offers an enormous living room with massive windows, a beautiful kitchen, a master bedroom, and a dual loft.
Based in Elkhart, Indiana, Recreation by Design is a third-generation family business with roots dating back to the 1950s. Unlike the big conglomerates that dominate the market, Recreation by Design doesn’t rely on standardized production. The company builds its own chassis and cabinetry in-house, an approach that allows it to focus on craftsmanship and gives it greater control over some aspects of the finished product, from its structure to the finishes that make an RV feel like home.
The 2027 Baypoint 435 is a new floor plan that has not yet been listed on the manufacturer’s website, so the exact spec list is still a mystery, but Recreation by Design did ship initial production units to dealership lots, and Hunter Megowen from The RV Hunter channel has already filmed a full tour, which you can watch below.
Photo: Recreation by Design As a destination trailer , the Baypoint 435 is not meant to travel frequently. Actually, it’s built for permanent site setup and offers features that make it feel more like a tiny home than an RV. Measuring about 44 feet (13.4 meters) long, this is a dual-axle model with four slide-outs and two entrances. It sits on an in-house-built chassis with heavy-duty I-beams made with certified steel and E-coat corrosion protection.
In terms of construction, the RV features vacuum-bonded laminated sidewalls and hardwood slide surrounds, which contribute to the overall durability, and the slide roofs use laminated fiberglass, which enhances protection against leaks. The company also reinforces the walls around the slide-outs with steel tubing, helping prevent the structures from bowing under their weight over time.
The defining features of the new floor plan are a front kitchen with large windows and a dinette, a beautiful central living area, tall ceilings, and a drop-frame rear bedroom. A large loft with a split design adds another sleeping area, making this destination trailer suitable for families or couples who like to host guests.
Photo: Recreation by Design The kitchen at the front benefits from spectacular views thanks to large windows all around, including a front picture window and an atrium window above the dining area. It is equipped with a full suite of premium GE appliances, ranging from a four-burner range with an oven and a microwave to a residential-style 12V refrigerator with a wine rack above it.
Solid-surface countertops, soft-gray cabinetry, and a ceramic subway-tile backsplash give the space a contemporary appearance . The dining space is located in the front slide-out and consists of a table with a flip-up extension and four chairs. A nice breakfast bar area with two stools is also integrated between the kitchen and living area.
Photo: Recreation by Design The living room is a nice open area with a huge L-shaped sectional sofa, a loveseat across the way, and an entertainment wall with a big TV, electric fireplace, and a sound bar. This setup, combined with tall ceilings and large windows, makes the entire space feel enormous. The sleeper sofa offers an additional bed for guests, and motorized shades on the large windows ensure privacy.
The bathroom is not very big but feels residential with dual stainless-steel sinks, a porcelain foot-flush toilet, a round mirror, storage drawers, and open shelving. The shower is a one-piece fiberglass unit with a seat cutout and four spray ports. Hot water is supplied by an on-demand Fogatti water heater.
Between the drop-frame bedroom, the large loft, and sleeper sofa in the lounge, the Baypoint 435 can accommodate as many as eight people. The master bedroom is designed as a private room with a queen bed and a large closet with cubbies, pull-out compartments, hanging rods, and a compartment with washer/dryer preparation.
Photo: Recreation by Design Above the drop-frame bedroom, the loft can fit two twin mattresses on one side and another double mattress on the other. Protection railings instead of a full wall and a reported headroom of 6 feet 6 inches in the slides maintain a sense of openness.
With its spacious, luminous interior and residential-style creature comforts, the 2027 Baypoint 435 might pique the interest of many, but there is one important aspect prospective buyers should take into consideration: the Baypoint does not include gray or black-water holding tanks in its standard configuration and comes with a residential toilet. That means it will have to be parked at a serviced campsite with a sewer connection. Holding tanks can be added as an option.
The exact weights, tank capacities, pricing, and additional specifications for the 2027 Baypoint 435 destination RV have yet to be revealed..
